nodes.title: 参考图条件 | 直接使用 TY 宽高与帧数
TY 当前分段输出 | 控制器最终精确裁切
SelfLift Avatar | Euler 6 low + 2 high / 1.5MP / 2 tiles H
TY Shot Planner | 唯一分段/尺寸/补帧入口
widgets_values:
body_swap:
subject_definitions: <Subject 1> is the complete target character depicted in <Picture 1>. The reference picture defines the character's head shape, facial features, body silhouette, proportions, surface colors, clothing, and distinguishing details. <Video 1> is a single-performer dance reference that defines the complete choreography, timing, camera, cuts, framing, background, and lighting.
summary: [video editing + reference generation] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>. Render <Subject 1> as the sole dancer from the opening frame through the final frame. Transfer the source performance and camera to this target character.
retention_analysis: <Picture 1>: fully_preserved target character identity and appearance in every view. <Video 1>: attribute_transfer of movement, rhythm, pose, framing, camera, and cuts; fully_preserved physical environment and lighting; partially_preserved source imagery with <Subject 1> occupying the performer role. Render the scene as clean camera footage, with natural scene content filling all image regions.
detailed_description: The opening frame shows <Subject 1> in the dancer's exact position and pose. Throughout the whole clip, the same character from <Picture 1> remains visible with its reference head, face, body shape, colors, outfit, and distinctive details while performing every source step, arm gesture, weight shift, turn, pause, and transition at the source timing. The character moves with natural weight and flexibility. Where appropriate to its anatomy, soft tissue responds to acceleration and changes of direction with subtle deformation, slight inertial delay, and gentle settling, consistent with its proportions and clothing support. Hair, clothing, and accessories follow the movement with natural inertia. Facial expressions respond naturally to the performance, with coordinated gaze, blinking, and subtle facial movement. The camera, composition, physical background, lighting, cut sequence, and final pose follow <Video 1>. Background surfaces and scene textures extend continuously across the full frame, including corners and edges, producing a clean cinematic image.
overall_soundscape: N/A.
non_diegetic_music: N/A.
